title: Remove the unused WebSocket layer, keep HTTP polling
purpose: No code calls group_send, so SimulationConsumer never sends anything. The WebSocket route is registered in HTTP urlpatterns and routing.py uses a tutorial path. Remove the layer and its dependencies (channels, channels-redis, Redis channel layer).

modify: abmem/urls.py (remove 'from abmem.consumers import SimulationConsumer' and the 'ws/simulation/<str:simulation_id>/' route only)
web_project/asgi.py (plain django.core.asgi.get_asgi_application, DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE set before the call)
web_project/settings.py (remove 'channels' from INSTALLED_APPS, remove CHANNEL_LAYERS and ASGI_APPLICATION)
requirements.txt (remove channels, channels-redis, daphne if present)

public_interfaces.description: Standard Django ASGI application without ProtocolTypeRouter.

invariants: All existing HTTP routes resolve with the same names.
edge_cases: Templates: verified by grep that no template opens a WebSocket (no 'WebSocket' or 'ws://' string under abmem/).
runserver must still work without daphne installed.
test_plan: tests/test_no_websocket.py: django.urls.reverse for every named route still resolves. importlib.util.find_spec('abmem.consumers') is None. 'channels' not in settings.INSTALLED_APPS.
